d:
Spain and Germany delivered an unforgettable showdown in the EuroBasket 2022 semifinals, with a place in the FINAL on the line!
Germany had home-court advantage and Dennis Schroder was on FIRE, finishing with 30 points and 8 assists. But Spain refused to back down! After trailing by double digits, Spain mounted a huge comeback, with Lorenzo Brown leading the way with 29 points and 6 assists.
Spain exploded for 31 points in the fourth quarter to take control and secure a thrilling 96-91 victory, sending them to the EuroBasket FINAL!
